Ballentine Partners Increased Apple (AAPL) Position by $10.35 Million; Petrus Trust Company Lta Has Boosted Its Intel (INTC) Position
June 10, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Ballentine Partners Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2478% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ballentine Partners Llc bought 61,950 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 64,450 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.81M, up from 2,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ballentine Partners Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $942.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.91% or $1.76 during the last trading session, reaching $191.7. About 26.47 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
